text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! A new personal best! I'm really 
getting the hang of breaking boards now!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you caught up already?! Guess I can't 
afford to slack off either.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Just you watch, C.B.! The one 
winning the "U.A.F." is gonna be me!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Ruby! Are you practicing karate too? 
Wanna have a board-breaking showdown 
together?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No. I have plans, you see. If you will 
excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Weren't you watching because you 
wanted to join in?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't reach it at all. Neither my 
own goal, nor those two...

text_block_list.name: Calligraphy Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...You pass. The waviness in your lines is 
gone. Keep up this momentum and do not 
neglect your practice.

text_block_list.name: Piano Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! That is the fruit of repetitive 
practice! In that case, it looks like I 
can prepare an even more difficult sheet 
for next time! Let's do our best, 
Ruby-san!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Be magnificent. Be supreme. As one who 
bears the family name, perfection is an 
absolute must."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Mediocrity... is something I cannot permit 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... ...One more time.

Heyyyy, C.B.---!!! Want me to teach you 
the trick to board breaking---?!

Fufu... Yessss! I'd love to hear some 
advice from an aceーーーーー!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"First of aaaaall! Fix your posture, then 
pull back firmly with your non-thrusting 
hand!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I seeeeee! Focus on the pulling hand, not 
the thrusting handdddd!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace's Voice
text_block_list.text:
Besides, keeping your cool is super 
important toooo! If you don't crack it in 
one hit, you start to panic! Relaxing 
might be the number one secret to it!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeeep breath— Huh!! Hah!! Taaah!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful to all of you for 
attending my tea party today.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Right back at ya, thanks a bunch! If 
I'd known I was gonna get treated like 
this, I would've brought a souvenir or 
something!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, so many pretty sweets. You picked 
these out for us, right Ruby? Keeping our 
preferences in mind, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It is my duty as your host.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks anyway. Then I won't hold 
back, I'm going to enjoy myself!
